timing: $300 bonus paid within 30 days of meeting requirements (approximately 90 days after account opening).
biggest_catch: A $300 penalty is imposed if the checking account is closed within the first six months — the entire bonus is clawed back. Payout takes roughly 90 days after opening.
eligibility: New Rewards (Kasasa Cash / Kasasa Cash Back) checking account holders — the $300 is a new-account bonus on the official checking page; MMFCU membership required: live, work, worship, or attend school in any of 10 central Minnesota counties, or immediate family member of someone who does. Limit 1 Kasasa account per SSN.
catches: The $300 bonus will be paid within 30 days of meeting the requirement (approximately 90 days after opening the account).
A $300 penalty will be imposed if the checking account is closed in the first six months.
Monthly qualifications: 1 ACH debit or credit, 12 debit card purchases, and receipt of electronic statements.
No minimum balance required to earn the bonus or open a Kasasa account; checking requires a $25 initial deposit and a $5 share savings balance for membership.
The $300 bonus is reportable income — you will receive a tax document.
Promotion ends at the discretion of MMFCU (no fixed expiration date listed).
There are no recurring monthly maintenance charges or fees to open or close the account.
steps: Confirm MMFCU membership eligibility (live, work, worship, or attend school in one of 10 central MN counties, or immediate family member of someone who does).
Apply for a new Rewards (Kasasa) checking account — Kasasa Cash or Kasasa Cash Back — online or in a local office.
Make the $25 initial checking deposit and open the $5 share savings account required for membership.
Meet the monthly qualifications each Monthly Qualification Cycle: 1 ACH debit or credit, 12 debit card purchases, and receive electronic statements.
After meeting the requirements for the qualification window (~60 days), the $300 bonus is paid within 30 days (approximately 90 days after opening).
Keep the checking account open for at least 6 months to avoid the $300 early-closure penalty.
